title: Removing Loose Impediments on the Green
question: On the putting green, which of these items can you remove without penalty when they are next to your ball?
explanation: On the green, you may remove leaves, twigs, and even sand or loose soil without penalty.

juniorVersion.title: Taking Things Away From the Green
juniorVersion.question: Which of these things can you pick up or brush away when they are next to your golf ball on the green, without getting a penalty?
juniorVersion.explanation: You can pick up or sweep away leaves, twigs, and even sand or loose dirt on the green and not get a penalty.

vocabulary.simpleMeaning: The smooth grass around the hole where you putt the ball.
An extra shot added to your score if you break a rule.
Things like sticks, leaves, or stones that are on the ground but not stuck to it.

juniorVersion.teachingTip: Show children how to gently clear away things like leaves or sand near their ball on the green without moving the ball.
likelyMisconceptions: Some children may think you can’t touch anything near your ball.
Some may not know sand counts as something you can remove on the green.
